title: Front-End/ Full-Stack Developer
description:
Securiti has been widely recognized as an industry innovator, being named “Most Innovative Start-up” at RSA Conference 2020, Leader in the IDC Marketplace, Leader in the Forrester Wave Privacy Management Software, and winner of the 2020 HPE-IAPP Innovation Award. The company is being built by proven serial entrepreneurs and executives who have successfully built and scaled high-growth global companies before. We have multiple frontend development roles open and if you aspire to work on cutting-edge technologies and frameworks, side by side with some of the smartest technologists, this may be a unique place for you. You will be working as a part of a distributed agile team, building a new SaaS platform that underpins a suite of enterprise applications solving a variety of hard data analytics and enterprise problems.

Responsibilities


 * Develop responsive front end applications using Vue JavaScript framework, HTML, CSS
 * Integrate with APIs by defining the contract and also building out APIs when required
 * Collaborate effectively with product owners, design, platform teams to define specifications and deliver features iteratively
 * Be passionate about code quality, security, testing, and performance
 * Work on features from end to end from design to launching it in production
   
   

Requirements


 * Full-stack or front-end engineer with a solid understanding of modern single-page web apps
 * Experience with relational database / NoSQL database
 * JavaScript with an in-depth grasp of asynchronous programming
 * Experience with one more scripting/programming language besides JavaScript
 * 2+ years experience in building responsive applications
 * 2+ years experience working with React/Angular/Vue.js or similar framework, developing single-page apps
 * Working experience with build systems like gulp/grunt, webpack, continuous integration (Jenkins)
 * BS in Computer Science or related engineering qualification
 * Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills
 * Good sense of humor
   
   

About Us

Securiti solves challenges across governance, privacy, and security. With a foundation in data understanding and a team that was responsible for developing and deploying the market-leading CASB & DLP technology, we were able to create a platform from the ground up that leverages automation and workflows to solve complex privacy, data, and security business challenges with a simplified interface promoting collaboration across the business. Ease of use, quick to deploy and customizable are all reasons why companies select Securiti versus stitching multiple vendors together to address their challenges.

The exponential growth of data brings massive new opportunities but also brings increasingly perilous security, compliance, and privacy risks. At Securiti, our mission is to enable organizations to safely harness the incredible power of data and the cloud by controlling the complex security, compliance, and privacy risks. Securiti’s solution uniquely combines AI-powered data intelligence with full workflow automation, simplifying compliance with GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, and other regulations. Granular insights into structured and unstructured data enable organizations to monitor risk, control access, and protect sensitive data at scale.

title: Associate Web Developer
description:
Devsinc is looking for a dynamic and driven Associate Web Developer to join our innovative team. In this role, you will assist in the design, development, and maintenance of web applications, working closely with senior developers to enhance your skills and contribute to exciting projects.

Key Responsibilities:


 * Assist in the development and maintenance of web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and various frameworks
 * Collaborate with team members to design user-friendly web interfaces
 * Participate in code reviews and contribute to the improvement of coding standards
 * Debug and troubleshoot issues to ensure optimal application performance
 * Stay updated with emerging web technologies and best practices
 * Help maintain comprehensive documentation for development processes and projects
   
   

Requirements

Qualifications:


 * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Web Development, or a related field
 * Familiarity with any web development technology stacks such as Python, Java, GO, Angular, React, Next and MERN Stack
 * Basic knowledge of web frameworks, libraries, or CMS (e.g., React, Angular, WordPress)
 * Understanding of responsive design principles and best practices
 * Experience with version control systems like Git
 * Strong willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies
 * Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

title: Associate Software Engineer- Open Stack
description:
We are looking for passionate and enthusiastic Associate Software Engineers to join our Open Stack team. This role is ideal for fresh graduates or individuals with up to 6 months of experience who are eager to learn, grow, and contribute to real-world projects.

Responsibilities:


 * Develop, maintain, and optimize web and mobile applications across multiple stacks
 * Apply core CS concepts including OOP, data structures, algorithms, and design patterns to build scalable and maintainable solutions
 * Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, implement, and improve features
 * Write clean, efficient, and reusable code following best practices

Benefits

title: Fresh Software Engineer
description:
Cogent Labs is hiring Fresh Software Engineers for its Lahore office.

 * Good understanding of software development concepts (via projects, coursework, or internships)

 * Responsible, with a no-giving-up attitude

Attractive Perks

Cultural Fit


 * Inclusive approach, high energy and integrity, attention to detail

title: Software Engineer - MERN
description:
Devsinc is looking for a talented MERN Developer to join our growing team. As a MERN Developer, you will be responsible for developing dynamic web applications using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js). You will work closely with front-end and back-end teams to deliver high-quality software solutions that meet business needs.

Key Responsibilities:


 * Develop and maintain web applications using the MERN stack, ensuring a seamless user experience
 * Design and implement RESTful APIs to connect frontend and backend components
 * Collaborate with UI/UX designers to translate wireframes and visual designs into functional web applications
 * Optimize applications for maximum speed, performance, and scalability
 * Write clean and maintainable code, adhering to best practices
 * Troubleshoot and debug applications, developing solutions to enhance performance
 * Participate in code reviews and contribute to team knowledge sharing
 * Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends
   
   

Requirements


 * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
 * 1+ years of experience in software development with a focus on the MERN stack
 * Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3
 * Strong working knowledge of MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js
 * Experience in building RESTful services and integrating with third-party APIs
 * Familiarity with Git version control and Agile methodologies
 * Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills
 * Strong communication skills and ability to work well in a team environment
   
   

Benefits

Provident Fund, Medical Inpatient Facility, Medical Outpatient Facility, Paid Overtime, In-house Subsidized Lunch & Dinner, Gym Facility, Entertaining Activities, Interest Free Loan Facility, Advance Salaries and Sports Allowance.

title: Front-end Developer in Karachi | Webnet Pakistan
description:
Job Description

Webnet Pakistan is looking for a Front-End Developer to join its IT team. We hope to hire someone who understands the position's responsibilities and can alleviate our workload with their invaluable services.

About Webnet Pakistan Pvt Ltd

Webnet Pakistan is a leading web development company specializing in creating high-quality websites, custom CMS solutions, and digital products for clients globally. We are looking for a talented Front-End Developer to join our team, with expertise in modern web technologies and a keen eye for UI/UX.

Job Responsibilities


 * Develop and maintain responsive and high-performance web applications.
 * Convert Figma, PSD, or XD designs into pixel-perfect, interactive web pages.
 * Write clean, scalable, and reusable code using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
 * Work with Blade templates in Laravel for front-end views and dynamic content rendering.
 * Develop dynamic and interactive components using React and Next.js.
 * Optimize web applications for speed, SEO, and accessibility.
 * Collaborate with back-end developers to integrate APIs and data-driven content.
 * Troubleshoot, debug, and enhance existing applications as needed.
 * Stay updated with the latest front-end trends and technologies.
   
   

Required Skills & Experience

✅ 3+ years of experience working in a software house.

✅ Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3 (SASS/SCSS), JavaScript (ES6+), and jQuery.

✅ Good understanding of Laravel Blade templates and integrating front-end with Laravel applications.

✅ Experience with modern front-end frameworks like React.js and Next.js.

✅ Hands-on experience with responsive web development and cross-browser compatibility.

✅ Understanding of SEO best practices for front-end development.

✅ Familiarity with Git and version control workflows.

✅ Experience working with RESTful APIs and third-party libraries.

✅ Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently.

Preferred Skills (Nice To Have)

➕ Experience with Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, and Material UI.

➕ Basic knowledge of Vue.js.

➕ Familiarity with Webpack, Vite, and build tools.

➕ Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies.

Why Join Us?

🌟 Work on innovative and diverse projects.

🌟 Competitive salary and growth opportunities.

🌟 Friendly and collaborative work environment.

🌟 Learning and development opportunities.

If you are passionate about front-end development and have the required experience, we’d love to hear from you!

Skills Required

Adobe Photoshop AngularJS Communication Skills CSS3 Fluent English Website Management Experience HTML5 JavaScript jQuery Laravel Framework Vue.js
